data.name: Binesh
data.gender_notes: Binesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Binesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bin' meaning wealth and 'Ish' meaning Lord. This name is associated with the god Ganesha, who is known as the lord of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. The name Binesh carries the meaning “Lord of wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Binesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Binesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Binesh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In Hindu culture, it symbolizes the desirable qualities of wealth, prosperity, and a connection to the divine. It holds a special place in the naming tradition, highlighting a deep reverence for the Hindu deity, Ganesha, who is believed to bestow wealth and good fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Binesh underscores the essential belief that the ultimate source of all material and spiritual wellbeing is the divine. By invoking the name of Binesh, one pays homage to the deity who is believed to hold the immense power to bestow wealth, prosperity, and wisdom. The name is a constant reminder to seek the blessings of the divine for one's material and spiritual growth.
